prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objective “best” — the right healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis depends on your organization, goals, budget, timeline and the services you need. I can recommend a specific agency if you tell me more, but here’s a quick, practical way to find the best fit and a short checklist of what to look for.

Questions I need to recommend agencies:
- What type of healthcare organization are you (hospital system, clinic, private practice, med device, pharma, healthtech startup)?
- Primary goals (patient acquisition, physician referrals, brand awareness, product launch, digital transformation, PR)?
- Monthly/annual budget or range?
- Timeline (ongoing partner vs. 3–6 month campaign)?
- Must-have services (SEO, paid media, creative/branding, content, digital product/UX, PR, analytics)?
- Any regulatory requirements (HIPAA, FDA clearance, Medicare/Medicaid focus)?

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Healthcare experience: case studies for similar clients (hospitals, clinics, device, pharma).
- Regulatory knowledge: HIPAA, FDA, CMS compliance and experience navigating them.
- Measurable results: examples with KPIs (lead cost, conversion rates, patient volume, revenue impact).
- Digital capabilities: SEO, paid search/social, website UX, CRM/EMR integrations.
- Creative and strategy: brand work + evidence it moved metrics.
- Reporting and analytics: dashboards, cadence, transparency.
- Team composition & accessibility: who will actually do the work.
- References: recent client contacts you can call.
- Budget fit and contracting model: retainer vs. project vs. performance.
- Local presence: is local community knowledge important (yes for many patient-facing needs)?

Where to find and compare agencies
- Clutch.co, G2, AgencySpotter for reviews and case studies.
- St. Louis Business Journal and local marketing awards.
- LinkedIn and company websites for team & client lists.
- Ask peers (other health systems, local medical associations).

Sample interview questions to ask agencies
- “Tell me about a similar healthcare client and the results you delivered.”
- “How do you handle HIPAA and patient-data privacy in campaigns?”
- “What KPIs will you use and how often do you report?”
- “Who will be on our account team and what are their backgrounds?”
- “What does success look like at 3, 6, and 12 months?”

If you want, tell me the details above (type of organization, goals, budget), and I’ll produce a tailored shortlist of 3–5 St. Louis agencies with notes on fit and questions to ask each.
